Justin Brundage website usability audit

Fix narrow-screen navigation and footer reflow first. Then address image loading, contact behavior, keyboard focus, and small-text contrast.

Audited site: jkbrundage.com → www.jkbrundage.com
Live observations: October 1, 2026, 20:09–20:27 UTC · Annotated edition prepared October 2, 2026

This is a dated live-site audit, not a current deployment check. The screenshots and measurements below come from the October 1 live audit. Production has not been rechecked for this annotated edition.

The separate local preview has two portability changes: a local Tailwind dependency and an existing portrait fallback for the missing hero. Those changes do not establish that the public site is fixed. The fallback is noted under finding 3; the other findings remain unverified on the preview.

Scope and useful starting points

This review covers technical usability: mobile-width and desktop layout, navigation, image loading, contact behavior, and accessibility risks. It does not evaluate campaign messaging or make a full accessibility-compliance claim.

The original live run covered Home, About, Policy, Community, Blog, and Contact at 320, 390, and 1440 CSS-pixel widths. Native Chromium windows used 200%, 150%, and 80% zoom respectively; the 1023 / 1024 px boundary used 100%. These are narrow-window reflow checks, not touch-device emulation.

Working foundations: Desktop navigation was visible at 1024 px; Contact fields had associated labels and required-field semantics; Blog expansion and collapse did change the visible content. The fixes below focus on the remaining interaction and presentation gaps.

  1. 1. Primary navigation disappears below 1024 pxHigh
  2. 2. Homepage footer links overflow the viewportHigh
  3. 3. Homepage hero image is missingMedium
  4. 4. Two Community images fail to loadMedium
  5. 5. The contact link names a fragment that does not existMedium
  6. 6. Blog expansion loses visible keyboard focusMedium
  7. 7. Several small text styles have low contrastMedium
  8. 8. The contact form depends on a configured email appNeeds verification
  9. 9. Unfinished citation tokens appear in Community textLow

Findings and matching fixes

Severity reflects the observed access or usability impact. “Needs verification” identifies an untested dependency, not a confirmed delivery failure. Every item is dated October 1, 2026 and remains a production recheck item.

1

High · All six pages

Primary navigation disappears below 1024 px

The desktop navigation is hidden below the 1024 px breakpoint, with no replacement menu. On inner pages, the header leaves only the home logo.

Reproduce
Open About at a 390 CSS-pixel viewport. Check the header for a way to reach Policy, Community, Blog, and Contact. Compare Home at 1023 and 1024 px.
Smallest useful fix
Add a keyboard-operable mobile menu or an always-visible wrapping link list. Give a menu button an accessible name, aria-expanded, and aria-controls; keep focus and dismissal predictable.
Pass check
Every main page can be reached by keyboard and pointer at 320, 390, 768, and 1023 px. Focus remains visible and no links overlap.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 320 px at 200%; 390 px at 150%; boundary 1023 / 1024 px at 100%. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 1
2

High · Home

Homepage footer links overflow the viewport

At the 390 px profile, document width was 418 px versus 380 px of content width. At 320 px, it was 384 versus 312 px. The footer navigation is visibly clipped on both sides.

Reproduce
Scroll Home to the footer at each narrow profile and inspect the first and last navigation links. Compare document scrollWidth with documentElement clientWidth.
Smallest useful fix
Let the footer link row wrap, use a responsive grid, or stack links. Remove widths or no-wrap rules that force the row beyond its container.
Pass check
No horizontal page scrolling is needed; every footer link is fully visible and usable at both profiles.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 320 px at 200%; 390 px at 150%. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 1
3

Medium · Home

Homepage hero image is missing

The live /static/pictures/hero.jpg request returned HTTP 404. The image had naturalWidth 0, and the hero displayed a large dark area with faint fallback text.

Reproduce
Load Home, inspect the hero, and check the image request and decoded dimensions.
Smallest useful fix
Point the image to the intended existing asset, or deploy the missing file. Verify image sizing, useful alt text, and crop at narrow and wide widths.
Pass check
The intended image returns successfully and decodes; its crop and surrounding text remain usable.
Local preview status
The separate local preview substitutes the existing portrait jbrundage.jpg. This is a fallback in the preview only, not proof that the live hero was repaired.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 1440 px at 80%; also recorded at 320 and 390 px. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 2
4

Medium · Community

Two Community images fail to load

Both external placeholder image slots were broken in the tested browser. Their decoded widths were zero; large blank card regions remained visible.

Reproduce
Open Community and inspect both card images after loading finishes.
Smallest useful fix
Use approved working local images, or remove the unused image regions. Keep appropriate alternative text and explicit dimensions.
Pass check
Both intended images decode and display, or the empty regions are deliberately removed without losing useful text.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes. This finding records the tested browser result, not an independently established outage for every visitor.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 1180 px at 100%; 1440 px at 80%. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 2
5

Medium · Home to Contact

The contact link names a fragment that does not exist

Activating the homepage contact link opened contact.html#get-involved at the top. The live DOM contained no element matching get-involved.

Reproduce
Activate the Home button labeled Support the Campaign, then inspect the destination fragment and matching element.
Smallest useful fix
Add id="get-involved" to the intended contact section, with scroll margin for the sticky header, or remove the unused fragment if the top is the intended destination.
Pass check
The destination matches the link intention and is visible below the header. Test keyboard navigation as well as pointer activation.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 1180 px at 100%. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 3
6

Medium · Blog

Blog expansion loses visible keyboard focus

Tabbing to See More produced a transparent outline with no box shadow. Expansion worked, but using the bottom Show Less button collapsed the section and left focus on BODY.

Reproduce
Tab to See More, expand with Enter, reach the bottom Show Less button, and activate it. Check the visible focus indicator and document.activeElement.
Smallest useful fix
Add a high-contrast :focus-visible style to the summary and controls. When the bottom button closes the details element, explicitly return focus to its summary.
Pass check
The focused control is always visibly identifiable, and collapse returns focus to See More without an unexpected jump.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 320 px at 200%. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 3
7

Medium · Home and Blog

Several small text styles have low contrast

Recorded ratios were 3.19:1 for amber on white, 2.89:1 on light gray, 3.07:1 on a pale badge, and 3.94:1 for homepage footer text. These small text styles fall below 4.5:1.

Reproduce
Inspect the computed foreground and effective background colors for small amber labels, See More, and the homepage footer; calculate contrast.
Smallest useful fix
Darken text on light backgrounds and lighten subdued footer text. Check default, hover, and focus states rather than changing only one selector.
Pass check
Normal-size text reaches at least 4.5:1 against its actual background; visible focus also has sufficient contrast.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · Computed styles recorded on live pages; screenshot examples at 320 and 390 px. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 1
8

Needs verification · Contact

The contact form depends on a configured email app

The form uses a mailto action with POST and text/plain. No site delivery endpoint or visible explanation of the email-app handoff was found. Delivery was not tested.

Reproduce
Inspect the form action and the instructions beside Send Message. Do not infer delivery from the presence of a form.
Smallest useful fix
Clearly explain that the action opens an email draft and provide the direct email link as a fallback. A server-backed form requires a separately approved delivery integration and end-to-end test.
Pass check
The user knows what happens before activating the button. Confirm the chosen flow across supported clients; do not show a sent confirmation unless delivery is actually established.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes. This is a dependency and verification gap, not a confirmed lost-message incident.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 1180 px at 100%; structure inspected without submitting. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 3
9

Low · Community

Unfinished citation tokens appear in Community text

Five literal [cite: 1] markers were present in visible page text.

Reproduce
Read the Community introduction and card text, or search the rendered text for [cite:.
Smallest useful fix
Replace each token with a real accessible reference where needed, or remove the unfinished token after checking the underlying source.
Pass check
No raw citation tokens remain. Any references are meaningful links with readable labels.
Local preview status
Not addressed by the local preview portability changes.
Evidence
Live https://www.jkbrundage.com · October 1, 2026 · 1180 px at 100%; 1440 px at 80%. Original screenshot · Annotated plate 2

Recheck on the actual deployment

  1. Open the public site directly. Record the date, final URL, browser version, actual CSS viewport, and zoom.
  2. Visit all six pages at 320, 390, 768, 1023, 1024, and 1440 px. Check the primary links, footer, image decoding, and horizontal scrolling.
  3. Use only the keyboard to navigate and to expand and collapse Blog content. Confirm visible focus and a predictable return position.
  4. Check the Home-to-Contact fragment and instructions. Test message delivery only with approval and an agreed test recipient.
  5. Measure the actual text colors again, inspect Community references, and attach fresh screenshots before marking any live finding resolved.

Evidence limits

This edition reorganizes an existing completed audit. It does not claim a fresh live-browser session on October 2. Screenshots cannot establish screen-reader behavior, actual email delivery, touch-device behavior, performance across networks, or full WCAG compliance. No forms were submitted, emails sent, or production files changed as part of the audit.

Measurements and interaction notes came from live DOM checks in the original run. The public source snapshot used for diagnosis was commit 9fccd18; source inspection alone is not deployment verification.

Prepared for a technical review of Justin’s website. Original screenshots are linked with each finding. This report is suitable to forward as a dated list of reproducible issues and proposed repairs.
